source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះក្រូចពោធិ៍សាត់ដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ / Climate Resilient Orange Growing Technique", Nov 2018, 23pp
text:
The guide ends with a blank cost-and-revenue worksheet template that farmers are encouraged to fill in for their own orchard, covering both the first-year establishment costs and the ongoing annual costs and revenue of a mature planting.

Cost line items in the template include: planting material (គ្រាប់ពូជ), planting holes (ជីគីមី), fencing/stakes, mulching material, irrigation equipment, fertilizer (chemical and organic), pesticides, labor, and other inputs, each with space to record the quantity, unit, and cost per unit. A second table covers post-harvest costs (transport, storage, packaging) so farmers can estimate their net income once fruit is sold. As with other MAFF/ASPIRE guides, the template itself contains no filled-in figures - it is meant to be completed with each farmer's own numbers.
